name: 5-Minute Pre-Call Discovery Research & Prep System
description: Thorough pre-call research takes up to an hour per meeting, making comprehensive discovery preparation unsustainable for AEs managing high call volume.
buyer: High-volume B2B Account Executives and SDRs/BDRs
core_problem: Thorough pre-call research takes up to an hour per meeting, making comprehensive discovery preparation unsustainable for AEs managing high call volume.
desired_outcome: Extract strategic account insights and tailored discovery triggers in under 5 minutes per meeting without sacrificing quality.
current_solutions: AI tools for discovery call preparation
Pre-call research templates and prep sheets
Manual LinkedIn profile and company lookup
solution_gaps: AI summaries often produce generic fluff rather than actionable discovery questions.
Manual research takes too long and leads to prep burn-out.
Existing prep sheets lack structured 5-minute timeboxes and rapid-extraction checklists.
possible_product: 5-Minute Pre-Call Research OS & AI Prompt Vault
basis: AEs spending up to 60 minutes preparing for a single discovery call require lightweight, systematic workflows to keep prep sustainable.

problems.statement: Thorough pre-call research takes up to an hour per meeting, making complete discovery preparation unsustainable for AEs managing high call volume.
problems.normalized_problem: Excessive time required for pre-call discovery preparation
problems.desired_outcome: Thoroughly prepare for inbound and outbound discovery calls in just a few minutes.
current_solutions: AI tools for discovery call preparation
Pre-call research templates and prep sheets
Manual LinkedIn profile and company lookup
attempts: Spending 60 minutes researching accounts before every discovery call
solution_complaints: Spending 60 minutes of research per call is completely unfeasible for active sellers.
